Title: Azure SQL—Public preview updates for mid-April 2022

Body.Content:
Azure SQL—Public preview updates for mid-April 2022

In mid-April 2022, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Create and utilize Azure Active Directory server principals in the master of a SQL Database. 
  • Backup history dynamic management view is now available in Azure SQL Database.
Body.Markdown:
Azure SQL—Public preview updates for mid-April 2022

In mid-April 2022, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:

Create and utilize Azure Active Directory server principals in the master of a SQL Database .

Backup history dynamic management view is now available in Azure SQL Database .
